service_name.description: Service name, or "(no value)" / "(no service)" placeholder for unset entries.

log_count.description: Total log entries from this service in the window.

error_count.description: Count of logs at severity "error" or "fatal".

error_rate.description: Pre-computed error_count / log_count, rounded to 4 decimals. Useful for ranking noisy services.

volume_share_pct.description: Share of total log volume in the window for this service (0–100).

severity_breakdown.description: Counts by coarse severity bucket (debug, info, warn, error+fatal).

active_rules.description: Enabled sampling rules whose scope includes this service.
